GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward on-pace oppo Caught Four Wide d Settled Down 6th Outside 5 Lengths Good Pace on, Under Pressure Turning for home Couldn'T Go On jock gave up x 200m, # struggled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam of the gelding, which weakened in the home straight, revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Went Forward Settled Down = Lead Inside Fast Pace on same to straightening up dueled from 400m to 200m Couldn'T Go On - Pace Suited Swoopers # Went Too Hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported although her mnt initially travelled comfortably in the lead, it then overraced and refused to settle when another runner improved to its outside near the 900m, and this resulted in the gelding weakening in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear, drew clear turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths clear, headed approaching 100m, kept on well # found 1 better
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re riding, rdr std he was instructed to lead, & after obtaining lead in early stages another rnr improved to his outside near the 1200m causing his mnt to race fiercely. He said whilst aware of the fast sectionals being set, he was unable to restrain mnt to set a more sustainable tempo due to the pressure on his outside. Added near the 700m when this other rnr commenced to weaken, he felt his mnt’s best winning chance was to try to maintain established margin, as he was of the view the gelding would begin to tire & give ground in the straight due to the fast race tempo.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled bit keen eased off heels @ 900m, Drifted Back Settled Down 2nd last 10 Lengths within 8 Lengths Straightening Up and Ridden Along , clear run home Kept Coming Closest on line was $71.00, was (xovnboff) # Sound eff/finale
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. When racing keenly, had to be restrained from heels near the 900m, and in this incident, the gelding overreacted and had to be severely checked. Continued to pull hard for some distance through the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 7 Lengths ? Settled Down Off Mid-Field Inside 12 Lengths off leader/winner 11th into Straight clear run home too much to do Just Held Ground (b/1st) # b/1st, slow out 7
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: If begins well, option to be further forward; settled worse than midfield after missing the start. Stood flatfooted as the start was effected and lost considerable ground (5L). Tnr rep was advised the gelding would be required to barrier trial prior to being permitted to race again. Since passed trial at Wyong 5/3/26.
